Definition: Eljashib, the name of six Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Eljashib is the name of six Israelites. In 1 Chronicles 3:24, the text says "and Eliashib."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eljashib matters because God knows His people by name — even the ones Scripture mentions only once.
